# Close Developer Platform

Build integrations, automate workflows, and extend Close for your team.

Whether you’re a [Close](https://close.com/) customer automating your sales process or a partner building an integration, the Close Developer Platform gives everything you or your AI agents need.

## Use cases

- **Push in CRM data** — Push leads, contacts, activities, and custom data into Close from your website or other systems via the [REST API](https://developer.close.com/api).
- **Sync data out** — Stream changes with [webhooks](https://developer.close.com/api/resources/webhooks), query the [event log](https://developer.close.com/api/resources/events), or pull [reporting metrics](https://developer.close.com/api/resources/reporting) and pipeline data into your BI tools, data warehouse, or design custom dashboards & reports.
- **Automate outreach** — Manage workflows with [sequences](https://developer.close.com/api/resources/sequences) or [bulk actions](https://developer.close.com/api/resources/bulk-actions/email), or send email/SMS programmatically.
- **Publish an integration** — Build for many Close customers with [OAuth](https://developer.close.com/integrations) and get listed in the [integrations directory](https://close.com/integrations/).
- **Power AI agents** — Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other tools direct access to Close data via the [MCP server](https://developer.close.com/mcp) — no code required.

## Getting help

Our [Support Team](mailto:support@close.com) can assist Close customers with any questions about the API.

Implementing something cool or want to chat about where our API is going? [Schedule a call](https://calendly.com/joe-close/api-chat) with Joe Kemp, VP of Engineering.
